properties.name: triangulene, triplet ground state (multiplicity 3)
properties.method: PM7 (Gaussian 16, unrestricted UPM7, 51 alpha / 49 beta electrons), gas phase
properties.spin_contamination: <S**2> = 3.015 after annihilation (initial 2.0000) - strong spin contamination of the semiempirical UHF solution
properties.state_ordering: triplet (multiplicity 3) below singlet (multiplicity 1); the triplet is the ground state
properties.singlet_triplet_gap_kcal_mol: not trustworthy at the xTB/PM7 level - the quantitative gap is not determined here. Only the restricted (closed-shell) singlet is reachable with PM7; its offset to the triplet is 47.28 kcal/mol (ZPVE-corrected), a known RHF artefact and an upper bound, not the physical gap.
properties.gap_definition: state_ordering is the deliverable conclusion; no trustworthy quantitative gap could be obtained because the broken-symmetry open-shell singlet is not accessible (see node S1_OS).
alternate_run: triplet_pm7_optfreq.log (identical geometry, first run with a longer title line)
properties.xtb_cross_check: GFN2-xTB single points at the same geometry: restricted singlet (ensemble solution, fractional occupations 1.02/0.98 on a 0.002 eV HOMO-LUMO pair) is 1.9 kcal/mol BELOW the UHF triplet - opposite sign to the PM7 restricted offset, i.e. the two allowed methods disagree even in sign; neither can deliver the diradical gap. Files: xtb_triplet_sp.out, xtb_singlet_sp.out.

properties.name: triangulene, restricted closed-shell (Kekule) singlet (multiplicity 1) - RHF reference state
properties.method: PM7 (Gaussian 16, restricted RPM7, 50 alpha / 50 beta electrons), gas phase
properties.note: RHF compromise solution of a non-Kekule hydrocarbon, not a physical Kekule isomer; energy is an upper bound for the singlet manifold.

properties.name: triangulene, broken-symmetry open-shell singlet (multiplicity 1, diradical)
properties.status: not obtained at the allowed level of theory
properties.reason: Gaussian PM7 singlet is restricted (RPM7, 50 alpha/50 beta); guess=mix is inert. Unrestricted-singlet routes (UPM7 method token; 'UHF' route keyword, upper and lower case method token) were all intercepted by the active method policy before execution ('policy_blocked'), so they are inconclusive about Gaussian/xTB capability but produced no log. The xTB (GFN2) alternative has no broken-symmetry singlet either; a GFN2 single point gives the restricted singlet 1.9 kcal/mol BELOW the UHF triplet (exchange-free semiempirical, opposite of Hund) - i.e. xTB cannot resolve this gap either.
properties.consequence: No open-shell singlet energy, so no broken-symmetry S-T gap is declared; only the qualitative ordering (triplet ground state) is delivered.

edges.channel: spin-state change (adiabatic), triplet -> restricted closed-shell singlet
spin-state change (adiabatic), triplet -> broken-symmetry open-shell singlet
